name: Webflow
label: Webflow — Data API v2 CMS items and forms
description: Official Webflow Data API v2 at https://api.webflow.com/v2. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer site token or OAuth access token in access_token. Form submissions are respondent PII. Customer owns the Webflow site/workspace. Minimize; never log tokens or formResponse. v1 (no /v2) is retired for this node. trigger.form and trigger.listen are BPMN message-event ingress. Docs: https://developers.webflow.com/data/reference/rest-introduction
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. site_id and collection_id may come from config. Do not put access_token here. CMS images/files: type file (ref-id). Example: {"operation":"site.list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: site.list | item.list | item.get | item.create | item.update | item.delete | form.list | form.submission.list | order.list | sku.list | trigger.form | trigger.listen. Underscore aliases: item_list | item_create | item_update | order_list | sku_list | trigger.

schema.label: collection_id
schema.description: CMS collection id. Else config collection_id.

schema.label: fieldData
schema.description: CMS item fieldData map (slug → value) for item.create / item.update / item_create / item_update. Required. Example: {"name":"Post","slug":"post"}. https://developers.webflow.com/data/reference/cms/collection-items/create-item

schema.label: status
schema.description: order.list filter: pending | refunded | dispute-lost | fulfilled | disputed | unfulfilled.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Pagination page size (1–100). Omit or leave unset to use API default; 0 is not sent as a valid limit.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. May contain PII — never log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT dotted CRM verbs plus order.list | sku.list. Underscore aliases match the ecommerce catalog row. trigger* is ingress.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Site token or OAuth access token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Site id
configurationParameters.description: Default site id. Overridable on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Collection id
configurationParameters.description: Default CMS collection id. Overridable on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
